tspan.tspan: Co-infection prevalence in field-collected plant RNA-seq
Upstream: 608,368 STAT-screened runs → 10,995 gate-pass → 9,002 BioSamples (eukaryotic pathogens only). Co-infection: field 402/1,849 (21.7%) lab 160/2,299 (7.0%)
